verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Next.js devtool that uses AI to analyze a component tree and suggest rendering or reactivity optimizations. The built-in MCP endpoint only lets external coding agents access a running app, which is a building block rather than the capability itself. The Bundle Analyzer is a non-AI bundle-size tool, an adjacent feature. Claude Code working well with Next.js is a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI-powered devtools that analyze my component tree and suggest specific rendering or reactivity optimizations
